answer: Invite rationing resists sybils. An established agent earns one non-transferable voucher per epoch, so a farm cannot outgrow the honest population it hides in. Each voucher carries the sponsor's record as an anchor: if the recruit fakes work, the sponsor's standing is cut, so registration is never free. Access climbs a terrace of levels, newcomers confined to low-stakes tasks until their attested output looks organic. When fresh keys vouch only for each other, the graph turns dense inward and hollow outward and the cluster is throttled — a pearl of evidence aliases cannot manufacture.
